nodes.label: main()

nodes.label: aeMain loop
nodes.desc: single-threaded event loop aeMain at L689; serverCron (server.c L1601) runs on it as a timed job

nodes.label: processCommand

nodes.label: readQueryFromClient

nodes.label: IO threads
nodes.desc: Valkey split async IO into io_threads.c: trySendReadToIOThreads L693, trySendWriteToIOThreads L742, processIOThreadsResponses L1324

nodes.label: String commands
nodes.desc: setCommand L265 and getCommand L356 on SDS strings; the workhorse types for caching and session workloads

nodes.label: Sorted-set commands
nodes.desc: zaddGenericCommand L1226 over listpack or skiplist encodings; drives leaderboards and time-series ranking

nodes.label: Path-hash commands
nodes.desc: new Valkey data type: phsetCommand L230, phgetCommand L320, phlongestCommand L458 for path-shaped keys like token prefix caches

nodes.label: Keyspace hashtables
nodes.desc: Valkey renamed dict.c to hashtable.c (hashtableCreate L1266); kvstore.c manages logical DBs (kvstoreMemUsage L378); db.c lookupKey L87 is the key-resolution chokepoint

nodes.label: RDB snapshots

nodes.label: AOF log

nodes.label: Replication
nodes.desc: syncCommand L1412 serves SYNC/PSYNC; feedReplicationBuffer L688 streams writes; dual-channel capability negotiated at L1510
